cves.title: SecurityContext GET /v1/cves/{cve} only (no search, products, stack or scan endpoints)

terms.quote: Terms 'unknown' (no terms published; operator ProjectDiscovery per the homepage, checked 2026-11-26; A1 BR16) and provider tier 'unknown' (A8): disabled in every profile until legal records terms.

cves.notes: Quote: binding council text (P188 cond 2); research C0433 (vulnx client MIT; service terms not reviewed). Observed 2026-11-26 from the research egress: anonymous 60 requests/min per address (x-ratelimit-limit 60, x-ratelimit-reset in RELATIVE seconds, headers on 4xx only), 404 {"found":false,"code":"not_found"} for an unassigned id, 400 {"code":"invalid_parameter"} for a malformed one; served by Cloudflare (a challenge is BLOCKED, never bypassed). Quota block: 60/min unpublished -> rate 1/s at 80%; min_interval 1.25 s until the HTTP client spends the token-bucket wait (WP10). POST /v1/scans, search, /v1/products, /v1/stack and every MCP tool are never built (P188 cond 1): only CVE ids (IOC_TYPES) are ever sent.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G08-1 (P188 securitycontext_cve, default off, unknown terms and tier). Neutral User-Agent (V3LUM/<version>): unknown-tier providers never get an identifying contact UA (A8).
